tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer – Backend Integrations & SAP Commerce Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and REST/OCC APIs, designing and operating robust data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven track record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, production support and performance tuning. Skilled in techno-functional analysis, stakeholder collaboration and AI-assisted development, ensuring reliable, scalable integrations aligned with business goals.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer – Operations
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Koro because of its innovative approach to seamless e-commerce operations and its commitment to flexible, high-impact engineering. With over 5 years designing and operating robust SAP Commerce Cloud integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend services, API development and data pipelines that align perfectly with the Operations focus.

bullets.label: **Backend Integrations**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST services that synchronized product data across ERP, MDM and external partners, ensuring reliable, scalable integrations.

bullets.label: **API Development**
bullets.text: I delivered high-performance REST/OCC APIs for headless commerce, handling high-volume traffic and supporting third-party consumption, mirroring Koro’s need for robust API layers.

bullets.label: **CI/CD & Cloud Ops**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, automating releases and maintaining system stability.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Collaboration**
bullets.text: I worked closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, driving cross-functional delivery and production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Koro.

tailoring.why_company: KoRo’s reputation for delivering fresh, high-quality products through a fast-moving e-commerce platform resonates with my passion for building reliable, scalable integrations that directly impact customer experience. I am attracted by your flexible working model, data-driven culture and the opportunity to shape backend services that connect ERP, logistics and finance systems, driving efficiency and growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce integration expertise to build robust, scalable backend services at KoRo, contributing to seamless e-commerce operations and innovative data flows.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior backend engineer with 5+ years of SAP Commerce integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to bring my API and data-pipeline expertise to KoRo’s Operations team. Open to discuss?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Software Engineer – Operations (Koro)
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Software Engineer – Operations role at KoRo. With over five years of experience designing and maintaining SAP Commerce Cloud integrations, API services and data pipelines for global enterprises, I am confident I can contribute to your backend operations. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
